Hi Cynthia —

Appreciate the clear list. We've pulled together a short package and a proposed approach; attaching two concise artifacts (governance_matrix.xlsx, eval_plan_v1.pdf) that map controls to NIST functions and outline our regression/eval cadence. High-level answers below, and we can deep-dive on the call.

1) NIST AI RMF mapping (brief):
- Identify: model inventory, tagging by use-case and risk tier, data lineage records.
- Protect: role-based access, KMS for keys, encryption-at-rest/in-transit, VPC option for Private deployments.
- Detect: runtime anomaly detection (latency/score drift), integrity checks, traceability logs with request hashes.
- Respond: automated fallbacks to baseline model variants, canary rollback policies, incident runbooks.
- Recover: point-in-time model deployment records, ability to redeploy pinned versions, archived evaluation snapshots.

2) EU AI Act positioning:
- For clinician-facing triage or anything that materially influences clinical decisions, we treat the deployment pattern as 'high-risk' for customers. Redwood's platform supports the conformity workflow by producing technical documentation (model cards, risk assessments, evaluation reports), offering Private deployment (so you control data flows and can perform internal conformity assessments), and integrating with third-party assessors when a notified body review is required. We do not self-declare CE marking on your behalf, but we provide the artifacts and test evidence your assessor will need.

3) Regression & eval approach (summary):
- Golden prompts and labelled test sets retained per account (isolated namespaces).
- Continuous smoke checks on canary releases (small % of production traffic).
- Periodic sampling: weekly automated sampling of 2k prompts for high-traffic apps, lower-volume customers get monthly sampling; thresholds are configurable.
- Quality regression triggers: relative metric degradation (e.g., ≥3% BLEU/ROUGE-equivalent or domain-specific metric drop) or increased safety/abuse signal rates. Triggers escalate to human review and rollback.
- We store evaluation snapshots and diffs; audit trail links to the model version, kernel/quantization profile, and exact prompt set.
